name: 20-stat-wrong-domain
description: Rule: stat entity must be an HA entity_id in sensor / binary_sensor / input_number / number / climate / weather.
input:
# HA Paper display config
version: 1
screens:
  - id: a
    widgets:
      - {type: clock}
      - {type: stat, entity: switch.coffee}

expect.message: stat: “switch.coffee” is not a sensor / binary_sensor / input_number / number / climate / weather entity
